claim: At revision 66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4, the README example at lines 143-155 reads node.entity.controlPoints and fails with TS2339 under the package's declared TypeScript 5.9.3, because Node.entity is typed Entity | undefined and controlPoints is declared on Geometry.
suggested_issue_title: README scene-enumeration example fails to type-check: Property 'controlPoints' does not exist on type 'Entity' (TS2339)
suggested_issue_body:
repository-presenter's validation pipeline (BC-03) recorded this while re-verifying `aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript`; it was then reproduced independently against the live default-branch head `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` on 2026-10-09T21:30Z.

## Summary

`README.md:152` is ``console.log(`  Control points: ${node.entity.controlPoints.length}`);``. `Node.entity` is typed `Entity | undefined` (`src/aspose/threed/Node.ts:62`); `controlPoints` is declared on `Geometry` (`src/aspose/threed/entities/Geometry.ts:51`), not on `Entity`. The snippet has no cast or narrowing.

## Environment

- Revision `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` (default branch `master`)
- Docker `node:22` (Node v22.23.3, npm 10.9.9); `npm install && npm run build` as the README Installation section passes with typescript 5.9.3 (package pins ^5.8.3)

## Steps to reproduce

Save README.md lines 144-154 (import path `./dist/aspose/threed`) as `ex2.ts`, then:

```sh
npx tsc --noEmit --strict --esModuleInterop --moduleResolution node --module commonjs --target ES2020 --types node ex2.ts
```

## Actual result

```
ex2.ts(9,54): error TS2339: Property 'controlPoints' does not exist on type 'Entity'.
```
The other three TypeScript fences in the README compile.

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:152`; README.md:68 and :224 describe `controlPoints` as Mesh/Geometry members
- `src/aspose/threed/Node.ts:62`, `src/aspose/threed/Entity.ts:5`, `src/aspose/threed/entities/Geometry.ts:51`, `src/aspose/threed/entities/Mesh.ts:3`

## Evidence

- `README.md`: lines 143-155, failing line 152 (revision 66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4; unchanged at the live head)
- `docker node:22: npx tsc --noEmit ... ex2.ts (typescript 5.9.3)`: 2026-10-09T21:30Z: ex2.ts(9,54): error TS2339: Property 'controlPoints' does not exist on type 'Entity'.
- `src/aspose/threed/Node.ts`: line 62: entity typed Entity | undefined; controlPoints declared at entities/Geometry.ts:51
